text: {"lessons":["I realized gains on Stocks E, D, and A, but those wins do not show that selling winners is a reliable strategy; past price moves do not predict what comes next.","I should not let my average cost or the pain of admitting a loss dictate a decision—judge each holding by its future prospects and role in the whole portfolio.","With no clear reason to trade and only a few decisions so far, holding can be sensible; I should avoid trading merely to lock in gains or react to short-term changes."]}
